payload.entry: schema-ops landed test-only under src/native/albums/update/ (protocol.rs, ops.rs, mod.rs) gated by #[cfg(test)] in albums/mod.rs; no public command. 17 update tests pass; 197 albums+records lib tests pass; cargo fmt clean; workspace clippy gate shows 0 errors. Wire examples for schema-spans: {"schema_version":1,"expect":"sha256:…","ops":[]} no-op; {"op":"album.set","set":{"label":"Eateries"},"unset":["plural"]}; {"op":"field.add","label":"Status","kind":"choices","position":0,"choices":[{"label":"To try"},{"label":"Liked","emoji":"💚"}]}; {"op":"field.set","field":"status","set":{"required":true}}; {"op":"field.move","field":"status","position":0}; {"op":"field.remove","field":"status"}; {"op":"choice.add","field":"status","label":"Regular","emoji":"🔁","position":2}; {"op":"choice.set","field":"status","value":"regular","set":{"label":"Regular","emoji":"🔁"}} (empty emoji removes icon); {"op":"choice.move","field":"status","value":"regular","position":0}; {"op":"choice.remove","field":"status","value":"regular"}. Undo restoration: field.add accepts restore_key, choice.add accepts restore_value; each only creates an absent key, never renames; field.remove inverse is add+follow-up field.set for required/default/min/max. Interfaces for schema-spans: protocol::parse_envelope(&str)->Envelope{expect,ops}; ops::apply_ops(&[Op],&ApplyInputs)->OpOutcome{after_raw,after_type,after_plural,per_op,derived_keys,consequence,inverse_ops,group_before/after}; ops::ApplyInputs{before_raw,before_type,before_plural,stem,folder,index_refs,other_fields,today}; ops::IndexRefs{index_by,index_facets}; ops::OtherAlbumField{path,key,storage,list}.

payload.entry: HANDOFF: schema-command consumes the test-only src/native/albums/update modules. Wire shape: parse_envelope accepts schema_version/expect/ordered ops; inverse op metadata is restore: {spans: [{key_path, expected, prior}]} with schema paths under record and exact entry bytes or null (see update/mod.rs examples). Interfaces: ops::apply_ops(&[Op], &ApplyInputs) -> OpOutcome; spans::apply_schema_ops(markdown, ops, aligned restorations, outcome, inputs) -> SchemaSpanEdit; plan::plan_update(vault, config_path, snapshot, registry, requested_stem, envelope, today) -> UpdatePlan. The plan returns one optional combined FileEdit plus read dependencies; semantic no-op returns edit=None and original album bytes without index repair. Run 28 album update unit tests with cargo test --lib native::albums::update.

Implemented reversible schema span edits and the snapshot-bound planner, including index composition, read dependencies, and no-op behavior. Verified: cargo test --lib native::albums::update (28 passed), cargo fmt --all -- --check, and git diff --check. Non-strict cargo clippy --lib --tests passes; strict -D warnings remains blocked by existing workspace lints.

LANDING AUDIT — NOT COMPLETE (2026-11-12). Read this epic (initially no notes), all three closed phase beads and all seven phase notes, approved plan:202611/album_schema_writer.md and outer plan:202611/album_schema_render_and_edit.md. Reviewed actual protocol, all nine ops, span/Undo planning, report fingerprint, dependency guards, shared transaction integration, CLI/completion/catalog wiring and tests, plus phase commits de5c0e56, a7b5efed, 859c1571. Final decisions remain gesture commits/mobile degrade/overloaded chord/no memory edits. The writer uses run_locked and the shared guarded commit path, but the original phase completion reports do not establish all promised acceptance.

FRESH EVIDENCE: cargo fmt --all -- --check passes. Fresh cargo build --bin bob succeeds (ToolRun e4899efe9e292220928eb8d6b60bb0b9). The built binary was probed only against synthetic temporary vaults. Script file:explicit:4ba442ece3ddd5ba8cac9f6c and results file:explicit:3dc194da13754b6cbd345f2b preserve reproducible inputs/output. Forward dry-run diffs were patched into temporary notes, then returned inverse requests dry-run; no real transaction/Undo pass claimed. (1) Removing an unused unlabeled text field or choices field with independent stored keys succeeds but its inverse returns schema_restore_invalid. New-entry patch_mapping ignores restore overrides; field.remove's semantic drafts also lose label absence/choice identities. (2) Moving category ahead of status reports group_after=category while a fresh list of its post-image reports group_field=status; ops duplicates grouping without the status preference. (3) Required URL field with one missing-value record reports newly_invalid=0; field_from_raw returns None for url and partially reconstructs other fields, and ordered impact comparisons use original rather than current fields. (4) Remove-last-unused-choice then add replacement refuses at op 0 although final schema is valid. (5) Set label Original -> Temporary -> Original on an initially quoted label reports changed=true and rewrites bytes/index. (6) Prohibited kind change on a used status field returns field=null/affected=null. All are epic-owned work, not follow-up tasks.

ACCEPTANCE GAPS: the 17 CLI tests lack the promised schema-during-pre-sync race, guarded record/membership/declaration races, and verifier/commit rollback plus concurrent-edit preservation. The index-reference CLI section merely discards an indexed string. Returned inverse removal of fields is not proven by the existing add-then-remove Undo test. The repair tale adds externally meaningful regressions and the real temporary-Git-vault walkthrough. No new just check or docs-check pass is claimed in this audit; never ran check-full.
